title: "About me"

I am a computer science and mathematics student moving toward quantitative finance. My foundation is in machine learning, optimization and algorithms, and I am now focused on applying those tools to markets, risk and trading.

## Background

I am studying the **Doble Grado en Ingeniería Informática y Matemáticas** (double degree in Computer Science and Mathematics) at the **University of Granada**, expected to finish in **June 2027**. The combination gives me both the mathematical grounding and the engineering skill that quantitative work demands.

My coursework and projects span machine learning and deep learning, combinatorial optimization, search and planning and low level systems (I built a compiler from scratch). Alongside that I build quantitative finance projects, most notably an interactive [financial dashboard](projects/financial-dashboard.qmd) with backtesting, risk metrics and forecasting.

## Experience

### Software Development Engineer Intern - Amazon

*Amazon Business, Homepage team. Summer 2026, three month internship.*

During my internship I worked on the Amazon Business homepage, helping modernize a customer facing UI widget by migrating it from a legacy rendering system to a new framework for both desktop and mobile. I built the widget backed by tests, took part in code reviews and used A/B testing to release changes safely and measure their impact. Beyond the technical side, I grew a lot in reading large codebases, owning a project end to end and collaborating within an engineering team.

## What I am working toward

A role in quantitative finance where I can combine rigorous modelling with real engineering. I use this site to close the gap between my current background and hands on quant work, by publishing projects and short technical notes as I go.

- **Programming**: Python, C, C++.
